name: mercury
comment:versions: Pinned to the exact versions the pre-monorepo repo had installed, not carets. Re-resolving them here turned this move into an upgrade: ^1.18.0 picked up @qdrant/js-client-rest 1.19.0, which dropped QdrantClient.search and broke the typecheck. Upgrading is a separate decision with its own testing; moving the code is not the moment for it.
